evidence.quote: Analyzed max CPC versus smart bidding, brand CPC optimization, non-brand target CPA, Performance Max and Google Shopping mix, audience performance, data-driven attribution, incremental CPA, lifetime value, affiliate commissions, and AI-assisted promotion performance using Namogoo.

Built automated weekly reporting across 10+ channels using Python, Databricks, SQL, blended Excel data, and Funnel.io to improve accuracy and decision speed.

Used regression models, prior-year/prior-period data, holdouts, geo-promotional tests, scale-up/down analysis, and budget reallocation scenarios to forecast investment outcomes and support recommendations involving substantial incremental media budgets.

Helped facilitate the transition of four to five agency relationships in-house, evaluating agency cost structures, prioritization, automation approaches, and the impact of newer Google machine-learning capabilities on legacy rule-based systems.

Increased monthly marketing volume from approximately $200,000 to $800,000 while improving ROAS from 1.5 to 3.5.

Created a robust spreadsheet-based inventory planning methodology used across multiple departments.

Designed the company's information architecture and ERP-system flow and implemented systems to increase productivity, efficiency, transparency, and collaboration.
Oversaw project management in a fast-changing e-commerce channels while protecting relationships with more than 650 B2B retailers.
Developed e-commerce-specific products with manufacturers and improved supply-chain processes.
Worked extensively with Amazon Vendor and Seller Central using both FBA and FBM, leading to additional marketplace/consignment initiatives including CastleGate, Target.com, and Costco.com.
Conducted daily financial analysis to identify niches and product opportunities.
Managed budget decisions through project-by-project cost/benefit analysis.
Developed and maintained multiple company databases to improve consistency across departments and support accurate financial and marketing reporting.
Coordinated execution and reporting across marketingnvironment and helped move the organization from a largely traditional, non-digital B2B model to a functional digital environment.
Expanded the business by adding multiple B2C e, sales, operations, finance, IT, product, and e-commerce functions.
Set up and managed more than 75 Google Ads/AdWords accounts with more than $276,000 in combined monthly spend.
Advised clients directly on business goals and how to allocate marketing funds across website development, SEO, email, paid search, display, mobile, remarketing, YouTube, and social media.
Used industry-leading analytical tools to study account performance and make data-driven recommendations.
Built Funnel.io reporting pipelines and presented consolidated performance data in Google Data/Looker Studio.
Created custom scripts for continuous monitoring of client marketing efforts.
Developed a repeatable Google Ads account-management system designed to maintain service quality across clients regardless of spend; the system was adopted by the company.
Built conversion and attribution models and designed A/B and multivariate tests across multiple levels of the marketing funnel.
Conducted keyword, audience, competitive, targeting, and messaging research to support campaign and growth recommendations.

Managed an eight-person e-commerce department and led paid search, outreach, lead generation, customer acquisition, website performance, and growth across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom.

Managed more than 150 campaigns across Google Ads/AdWords, Microsoft/Bing Ads, Yahoo Gemini, Amazon Marketing Services, search, shopping, display, video, remarketing, mobile, social, local, email, and related campaign types.
Managed approximately $400,000 in media budget that generated more than $9 million in revenue, representing approximately 35% of total company revenue.
Conducted advanced keyword research, channel analysis, trend monitoring, acquisition analysis, conversion-path and funnel analysis, landing-page optimization, and conversion-rate optimization.
Created custom attribution models, advanced bid strategies, bid tests/experiments, A/B tests, and multivariate testing frameworks.
Developed affiliate-program strategy and created search/display ad copy using Adobe design software.
Implemented human-assisted campaign automation with JavaScript based on promotions and business goals.
Created business goals, annual projections, and KPIs with senior management and reported data from Magento, Google Analytics, ACCTivate, QuickBooks, and advertising platforms.
Conducted competitive analysis and used Excel, Google Ads Editor, Bing Ads Editor, and Amazon Premium Analytics for advanced performance analysis.
Worked with the web development team and monitored SEO/SEM using multiple software tools.

Designed and introduced new marketing concepts using graphic-design and animation software.

Conducted comprehensive market research and helped persuade management to add new services; worked with leadership to create tax and finance departments that together contributed more than 25% of firm revenue.
Developed the firm's overall marketing plan and new strategies in coordination with firm management.
Routinely conducted cost/benefit evaluations of marketing initiatives.
Managed online marketing efforts using multiple SEO/SEM tools.
Designed and built the firm's website using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
Developed and managed content strategy covering timing, content type, placement across blogs/mail/email/web, content focus, and personalization.
Managed weekly marketing meetings and participated in weekly firm management meetings.
Generated and tracked prospective clients and business associates using a marketing-oriented database.
Converted paper forms into electronic, interactive formats using Adobe Acrobat and LiveCycle, increasing the speed and quantity of market-data acquisition.
Managed up to $30 million per month in paid media with a four-person team at TravelPass Group, supporting high-volume account operations and disciplined budget oversight.
Managed 12 accounts, 32 campaigns, approximately 110,000 ad groups, and 1.6 million keywords with approximately $3.6 million in monthly spend for a single brand.
Managed 75+ Google Ads accounts with more than $276,000 in combined monthly spend while advising clients on channel allocation, campaign structure, and growth priorities.
Scaled monthly marketing volume from approximately $200,000 to $800,000 while improving ROAS from 1.5 to 3.5 through bidding, audience, budget, campaign, and conversion optimization.
Managed 150+ campaigns with approximately $400,000 in monthly spend, generating more than $9 million in revenue and approximately 35% of company sales.
Helped modernize a traditional B2B distributor and add multiple B2C e-commerce channels while protecting relationships with 650+ existing retail partners.
Used market research and business planning to help establish tax and finance departments that together contributed more than 25% of firm revenue.
Built automated reporting across 10+ marketing channels using Python, Databricks, SQL, Excel, and Funnel.io.

resume.name: DAVE CALL
resume.headline: Digital Marketing | Paid Media | E-Commerce | Analytics | Marketing Technology/AI
resume.summary: Digital marketing, paid media, e-commerce, analytics, and marketing-technology leader with 14+ years of experience across agency, in-house, B2B, B2C, e-commerce, professional services, and high-volume performance marketing environments. Experience spans Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, multi-channel media, SEO/SEM, e-commerce operations, conversion tracking, attribution, forecasting, statistical modeling, automation, database/reporting systems, website development, and cross-functional leadership. Combines marketing strategy with strong technical capability in Python, SQL, JavaScript, VBA, APIs, data visualization, and modern AI-assisted workflows. Known for learning quickly, building scalable systems, translating complex analysis into practical business recommendations, and improving both marketing performance and operational efficiency. Extremely proficient in using Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, and many other supplemental AI systems. I use all of this AI to enhance my foundational knowledge and amplify output.
